resources.title: Day 72 — Air-Gapped GenAI Deployment Architecture for a Hospital (Microsoft L6 Azure) — ScaleDojo
resources.content: System-design interview worked answer: hospital wants GPT-4 internally but data cannot leave servers. 7-step architecture — define air-gap requirements, self-hosted open-weight model on-prem (GPT-4 itself is API-only, disqualified), physical network isolation (no outbound DNS/NTP, firewall-blocked telemetry), manual checksum-verified model updates via physical media/data diode, fully internal logging/monitoring, on-prem fine-tuning on local GPUs (PHI never leaves boundary), continuous network-scan audits of the boundary.
